priority: Selective continuous volumetric segmented spine/rib chain flowing along an actual G6 cloth-like wrinkle, with deep grooves between connected nodes and coherent bends/merges. Retain calm cloth grounds.

reference_interpretation.observed: Connected solid ribs, recesses and ordered formations change scale and bend with larger folds. Facets and oblique cell edges can be coherent.
reference_interpretation.not_proved: Exact reference subdivision weights, ancestry rules or pass count. Fine horizontal fabrication bands are not the algorithmic ornament target.

parent_and_region.immediate_parent: Actual G6 MIDDLE body wrinkle geometry; original macro8S rails are a different level.
parent_and_region.close_region: Existing close_oblique view: central S shoulder and middle-lower return junction; keep this camera unchanged.
parent_and_region.before_forming: Bind one actual 3D parent trace and selected landmark vertex IDs/coordinates from the saved source. Do not use camera coordinates to place the ornament.
record_measurements: parent trace location and width relative to the same source landmarks
parent_and_region.interpretation: Measured movement supports macro preservation review; no invented universal tolerance or automatic beauty score.
parent_and_region.placement: Old G7 mask/phase placement is not mandatory. Parallel inherited phase alone does not prove a spine or 2D organization.

render_contract.scene_source: control receipt actual_views and conditions; same flat material, lighting, samples and camera per paired view
render_contract.native_geometry: Render the actual saved candidate native XYZ/faces. Bind file/array hashes, counts, Blender display readbacks and PNG receipts; no remesh, smoothing or image edits for presentation.
render_contract.topology: Genuine generated topology changes are allowed and documented; compare counts to the candidate receipt, not to baseline counts.

internal_visual_checks.pass: Trace a clearly visible volumetric segmented chain along the S bend into its return. Connected nodes and intervening deep grooves read as one organized structure, not isolated ornaments.
Node/rib-row frames turn with the actual G6 wrinkle; transverse ribs/recesses support the chain and its coherent merge or divergence. Individual facet edges need not be parallel.
Parent fold, chain/node mass and smaller recesses are distinct in actual geometry under the same flat lighting; meaningful depth replaces mere cross-pleating.
Whole view retains the good broad cloth-like S flow and calm planes; selective ornament has clear contrast against those grounds. Review recorded source landmarks alongside the image.

fail_conditions: Minor or effectively invisible change from control.
Support band bends but internal geometry remains unrelated cross-pleats or a fixed grid.
Uniform waffle/cell/fractal coat overwhelms the cloth grounds.
Sharp foil plates, microserrations, disconnected-looking cups or clumped junctions replace coherent connected mass.
Literal anatomical bone graft used as a substitute for generated flowing structure.
A flattering crop/light/shading change is needed to conceal a failed whole or close view.

decision.basis: Human structural and visual review of one actual candidate plus provenance; vertex/face counts, orientation statistics or phase angles cannot confer beauty.
decision.if_fail: Record a concise text-only internal verdict; do not show/export a poor or minor candidate and do not start a variant sweep.
decision.if_pass: Root reviews both whole and close evidence before showing the user. Visible improvement is required; artifact review is distinct from final beauty adoption.
